result.stdout:
Description:

Usage:
  FilestarCli [command] [options]

Options:
  -i, --input <input> (REQUIRED)                      Input files - absolute, relative or pattern
  -o, --output <output>                               Output path
  -c, --command <command>                             Command, i.e. "convert to jpg"
  -p, --parameters <parameters>                       Skill parameters, one name:value per argument: -p Quality:80 Format:cube
  -r, --recursive                                     Find files in subdirectories
  --output-template <output-template>                 Output path template, i.e. "<Filename>.<Extension>"
  --loglevel <Headless|Normal|Quiet|Verbose>          Log level [default: Normal]
  --recipe <recipe>                                   Path to recipe file
  --cloud <Allowed|Disallowed|Forced>                 Cloud policy [default: Allowed]
  --output-conflict <AppendNumber|Replace|Skip|Warn>  Strategy to use if there are conflicting filenames [default: AppendNumber]
  --version                                           Show version information
  -?, -h, --help                                      Show help and usage information

Commands:
  register <key>
  update
  version
  unregister
